sources.title: 007: The World Is Not Enough
sources.supports: Nintendo 64 identity; title and alternate regional titles; developer Eurocom Developments; publisher Electronic Arts; action/first-person/shooter classification; one-to-four player metadata.

sources.title: 007: The World Is Not Enough - Nintendo 64 specs
sources.supports: Nintendo 64 player count; multiplayer free-for-all/team/bot modes; Controller Pak, Expansion Pak and Rumble Pak support; ESRB, USK, ACB and ELSPA rating metadata.

sources.title: 007: The World Is Not Enough - Data
sources.supports: Nintendo 64 developer, genre and players; US product identifier transcription NUS-N07E-USA and UPC 014633141849; European identifier transcription NUS-N07P-EUR; US and European date metadata.

sources.title: Nintendo 64 Master List
sources.supports: Nintendo 64 release-list entry for 007: The World Is Not Enough; Eurocom and Electronic Arts attribution; North American and PAL dates; identifier transcriptions NUS-N07E-USA and NUS-N07P-EUR.

sources.title: Nintendo 64 World Wide Cartridge Release List

sources.title: Nintendo 64 release list
sources.supports: Independent worldwide release-list corroboration for Gradiente Brazil, US cartridge-color variant and physical regional identifiers NUS-NO7E-USA, NUS-NO7P-FRA, NUS-NO7P-NOE and NUS-NO7P-UKV.

sources.title: 007: The World is not Enough - United States first print
sources.supports: US first-print blue-cartridge variant; 256 Mbit cartridge; four players; English box/manual/text metadata; barcode 014633141849; component identifier transcription NUS-N07E-USA; ESRB Teen.

sources.title: 007: The World is not Enough - United States first print content
sources.supports: US first-print physical component inventory and scan availability for box, cartridge and manual.

sources.title: 007: The World is not Enough - United States second print

sources.title: 007: The World is not Enough - United States second print content

sources.title: 007: The World Is Not Enough - NUS-NO7E-USA
sources.supports: US physical metadata: GamePak ID NO7E, region USA, 256 Mbit, one-to-four players, Box ID NUS-NO7E-USA, barcode 014633141849, Manual ID NUS-NO7E-USA, Controller Pak, Rumble Pak and Expansion Pak.

sources.title: 007: The World Is Not Enough - Images
sources.supports: Discovery page for inspected direct front/back image assets for North American, French and German Nintendo 64 packaging.

sources.title: 007 : Le Monde ne Suffit pas - France

sources.title: 007: Die Welt ist nicht Genug - Germany

sources.title: 007: The World Is Not Enough - NUS-NO7P-UKV

sources.title: 007: O Mundo não é o Bastante - Brazil
